messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — I'm going to flip the feature flag `multi_region_failover` into canary for account acct-1234. Scope: enable sticky routing with a fallback region for cross-region failures. Targeting 10% of eu-west traffic as the canary starting in 10m.

maya: Can you paste the exact flag config you'll apply? Need guardrails (latency/error thresholds) before we go live. Also add the runbook link pls.

sam: Important: when fallback kicks in, ensure we route to `model-compat-1` variant (quantized) to limit memory pressure on us-east-2. Otherwise we'll saturate GPU pools.

alex: Config (will apply via internal toggle service):

```
flag: multi_region_failover
enabled: true
scope:
  accounts: [acct-1234]
  regions: [eu-west-1]
rollout:
  percent: 10  # percent of traffic originating in eu-west
routing_policy: sticky_with_fallback
fallback_region: us-east-2
fallback_model_variant: model-compat-1
sticky_ttl_seconds: 1800
circuit_breakers:
  latency_p99_ms: 500
  error_rate_pct: 1.0
  consecutive_failures: 5
alerts:
  - metric: request.p99.latency
    threshold: 500
  - metric: requests.5xx.rate
    threshold: 0.01
```

li: I added dashboard tiles for p99, 5xx rate, and cross-region egress cost to the acct-1234 dashboard. Runbook: https://internal/runbooks/multi-region-failover — include this in the flag description.

danny: Pinged eng-runtime to make sure KV cache warming is in the canary path. If sticky creates cold KV caches we'll see latency spikes. Also +1 on fallback variant.

maya: Guardrails OK. Add an automatic rollback rule: if p99 > 700ms OR 5xx rate > 2% for 3m, auto-disable flag for acct-1234 and page oncall. Also add a soft rollback for cost: if cross-region egress > $2000/hr for acct-1234, notify but don't auto-rollback.

alex: Will add auto-rollback rules. Schedule: flip in 10m, monitor for 30m, then increase to 25% if clean. Rollback plan in place.

ops-bot: [deploy-bot] flag `multi_region_failover` scheduled to toggle for acct-1234 at 2024-12-24T15:30:00Z.

maya: Please include the exact CLI command so I can approve in the audit log.

alex: CLI command I'm going to run: `rdwctl feature toggle set multi_region_failover --account acct-1234 --percent 10 --meta routing_policy=sticky_with_fallback --meta fallback_region=us-east-2`

maya: Added a required approver step for production flags; pinging @maya for approval.

maya: Approved. :thumbsup:

danny: PR #4567 (flag gating + metrics) is merged to main. CI passed.

alex: Rolling out now. Watching p99 and 5xx.

sam: I'll watch GPU pool metrics in us-east-2, and ensure model-compat-1 instances spin up.

li: Oncall watching. If you see a spike, escalate to #incidents and call the oncall pager.

alex: All good for first 5m — p99 = 120ms, 5xx = 0.02%. No cost spikes.

maya: LGTM. If 30m stable, bump to 25%.

ops-bot: [monitor] Alert rule `multi_region_failover_p99` triggered? false. All green.

alex: Leaving notes in the flag description and the rollout ticket. Thanks everyone.

maya: Nice, thanks for coordinating. Quick retrospective after full rollout to capture any infra tweaks.

sam: FYI: might want to add a sticky cookie TTL metric to dashboards; I'll open a quick follow-up.

alex: Will do.
